name: Diana Bryn
bio: Louis Wilkinson's third wife, married after Ann Reid's death in 1932 and divorced at an unrecorded date. Nothing else about her appears in anything read - she is the least documented of the four wives, resting on a single Who Was Who mention.
bio_note: NO DATES OF ANY KIND, for her or for the marriage. The article's only support for her is the Who Was Who entry on Wilkinson. She and the other three appear, lightly fictionalised, in his novel Forth, Beast. Louis Wilkinson married four times, was twice widowed and twice divorced. The Wikipedia article is footnoted PER MARRIAGE, which is why it is used here where Le Gallienne's is treated far more warily - Gregg to Bayley (1995) and Wilhelm (1990); the 1923 divorce to a T. S. Eliot letter of 9 February 1929; Ann Reid to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends (1953) dedication and to Friedman (2002), with her 1932 death to Elwin (1946), p. 207; Diana Bryn to Who Was Who; Joan Lamburn to his Times obituary. Wikidata Q26435237 records only Gregg and is incomplete rather than contradictory. ONLY THE FIRST MARRIAGE AND THE FIRST DIVORCE CARRY DATES; the other three weddings are undated in everything read and are entered undated.
